verdict.rationale: Claude's first-party docs describe a unified directory where users can find and install skills, connectors, and plugins in one place (claude-docs-17, claude-docs-30). This is backed by documented third-party connectors such as Google Workspace (claude-docs-19), custom remote MCP connectors (claude-docs-31), and local MCP servers that install as easily as browser extensions (claude-docs-64). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the directory experience, and detail on the directory's breadth of third-party listings and browse/search UX.
